name: Candied Oblivion
source:
You play as a man in an existential crisis and meet two very special women. An artistic redhead who loves human connection will take you out of your head and gas station. And a spunky firebrand who will take what she wants.

Redheads, candy, and the meaning of life. In the face of death, have some fun.

[From [url=https://thesugarray.itch.io/candied-oblivion]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演一个陷入生存危机的男人，并遇到了两个非常特别的女人。一个热爱人际关系的艺术红发女郎会带你走出你的头脑和加油站。还有一个勇敢的煽动者，她想要什么就会得到什么。

红发、糖果和生命的意义。面对死亡，也要享受一些乐趣。

[来自[url=https://thesugarray.itch.io/candied-oblivion]itch.io[/url]]
